id: ROCK’EN’ROL - Rogue And Vagabond's Jazz Extravaganza-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: ROCK’EN’ROL - Rogue And Vagabond's Jazz Extravaganza
long_description:
In association with Space Academy in Ōtautahi and Whammy in Tamaki, Rogue & Vagabond presents a day of jazz!

Join us for an veritable smorgasbord of Poneke's young jazz talent all in the name of reminding and encouraging people to enrol to vote to vote in this years general election.

Midday until 8:30!

FREE ENTRY - Koha for the bands encouraged!

ROCK’EN’ROL is a collective of Independent Music Venues, across the Motu, uniting to help get rangatahi/young adults enrolled to vote!

Venues are joining forces with local hip-hop crews, punk bands, pop & folk artists, DJs, community leaders, comedians, rabble-rousers & local legends to help create a whole lot of events!

The kaupapa is simple: provide enrolment support + a great event, to encourage youth participation.

By making enrolment easy, visable & accessible, independent music venues are uniting in support of rangatahi/young adults getting enrolled to vote, ready for the upcoming general election (just around the corner)!

New voter restrictions means voters must be enrolled - and have updated their address (if they’ve moved) - by midnight on Sunday 25 October!!!

People will no longer be able to enrol at a voting place/on the day, nor can folks enrol during the fortnight leading up to election day!!!

Election Day is Saturday 7 November.

If you enrol by midnight on Sunday 4 October you’ll be sent an EasyVote card, making voting faster & easier. Highly recommend.

id: Slow Jazz Ensemble w/ Synthia x Ghanjee-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Slow Jazz Ensemble w/ Synthia x Ghanjee
long_description:
Two of Te Whanganui-a-Tara’s favourite groups have teamed up for an exciting cross-genre set as part of Wellington Jazz Festival 2026!

Witness Synthia x Ghanjee's irresistible electronic grooves meet the explorative improvised landscapes of Slow Jazz Ensemble as they break new ground on the dance floor.

$20 online, $25 on the door, $15 students on the door

Part of the Wellington Jazz Festival 2026
